lines: CHANGELOG.md has no section for version-to-be-replaced.
A tagged pre-release is a release of its own: make changelog writes its section and make tag asks for it. The App Store shows it with the stable version.
The App Store shows no changelog on the page of version-to-be-replaced.
For a version with a '-' it reads the Unreleased section, which is empty. The section of version-to-be-replaced appears with the stable version, below that release's own section.
